settings.text: Direct foot traffic with visual cues and important safety messaging

settings.title: Hand Washing Message Mats
settings.text: Use these message mats to direct people to sanitize their hands. Perfect for sanitizer dispensing stations, these mats will grab the attention of your employees or customers and encourage them to sanitize their hands. Choose from a variety of colours, designs, and messages.

settings.title: SURE STRIDE DIRECTIONAL MATS
settings.text: These directional mats are adhesive-backed and printed with an arrow to provide directional cues to customers, visitors, and employees. Mats can be left in place during daily floor cleaning; floor scrubbers, mops, and brooms will pass right over them without causing damage.

settings.title: STICK-AND-STAND MATS
settings.text: These adhesive-backed mats are designed to clearly mark floors and provide customers with a safe place to stand while waiting in lines. Universal "stop sign" shape with shoe prints marks where customers should stand; mats can be placed at safe intervals in virtually any configuration.

settings.title: Promote Safety in the workplace and public spaces
settings.text: Help direct users to sanitization areas with the use of mats. Safety messaging encourages users to take action and promotes frequent washing of hands and use of hand sanitizer.

settings.title: Manage traffic with directional cues
settings.text: These mats are designed to communicate and direct traffic to certain areas of your premises for safety precautions. Help guide traffic around your spaces while maintaining distancing and proper safety guidelines. Allow users to find visual cues that direct them to take the appropriate actions.

settings.title: Designate queue standing areas
settings.text: Stick-and-Stand mats are adhesive-backed mats designed to clearly mark floors and provide customers with a safe place to stand while waiting in lines. Facilitate safe social distancing at your establishment easily with stick-and-stand mats that are easy to clean and are anti-microbially treated

settings.title:
SNOW, MUD
& DAMAGE
settings.subheading: CONTAIN THEM WITH THE FLOOR DEFENDER

settings.text: The underside of Floor Defender Pro Garage Containment Mats features a tatami grain pattern for increased traction. This patterned backing prevents these mats from lifting and allows them to retain their shape over extended periods of time. Also, the tatami grain patterned backing produces a smoother, less wrinkled surface than the smooth backed regular Floor Defender Garage Containment Mats.

settings.subtitle: GARAGE FLOOR PROTECTION
settings.title: NO MUDDY MESS
settings.text:
Dirt, Dust, and Debris are no problem as the Floor Defender Containment Mat catches it all and keeps it from being tracked into the house.

The Floor Defenders will hold up to 62 gallons of water at once and keep it off your floors until you are ready to safely empty it outside your garage.

settings.subtitle: ROLL OUT AND LAY DOWN
settings.title: HASSLE-FREE INSTALL
settings.text: Incredibly easy to use, the floor defenders unlike some other garage containments mats come ready to use. The single piece construction allows you to simply roll the mat out and lay it on your floor.

settings.subtitle: GARAGE FLOOR PROTECTION MATS
settings.title: PROTECT AGAINST CHEMICALS
settings.text: Keep oil, geese, anti-freeze, and other chemicals that may drain out of your car contained, and away from other possessions stored in the garage.

settings.subtitle: Improved
settings.title: EASY CLEAN UP
settings.text: Floor defenders are very easy to clean, simply drag the mat outside with all its contents and hose it down. In a matter of minutes, the mat is ready to be redeployed and used all over again.

settings.title: SIMPLE & COMPACT STORAGE
settings.text:
Although the Floor Defender Mats can be used year round, some of our customers prefer to only have the mats out in the winter.

Storing these mats after winter is incredibly easy. Simply roll them back up into a compact size and store it way in your garage.
